Check Output Contract

Check output contract using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

check_output_contract(text, contract)

Example input

{
  "text": "```ts\nconst n = 2;\n```",
  "contract": "code-only"
}

Example output

true

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py check_output_contract < examples/check-output-contract.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
